//synthesiseCover: The manuscript's cover is three floating text boxes (title, 'Form', the byline, a lone '3') plus a second plain-text copy that splits the subject over two lines — 'RELIGIOUS' / 'EDUCATION' / 'FORM 3' / 'LEARNER'S BOOK'. Read as-is, the cover printed 'RELIGIOUS' as the whole subject, 'FORM 3' twice, and 'LEARNER'S BOOK' and the publisher's address as the authors. Synthesised instead from the subject, the form and the book type.
subject: Religious Education
//authors: The four authors exactly as the manuscript's own cover byline gives them ('E.B. Mumba, S.M. Maseka, M.S. Yamba and E. N. Zimba'), split into four so the cover reads AUTHORS; only the stray space in 'E. N.' is closed up to match the other three. Written out in full (as the AUTHORS biographies give them) the four names wrapped onto a second line on the title page and pushed its last line, 'Lusaka', onto a page of its own.
//tables: KEY COMPETENCES. The manuscript builds the list as two tables: competences 1-5 in three columns (SN, COMPETENCE, DESCRIPTORS, each descriptor bulleted inside its cell) and 6-11 in FOUR, with the bullets in a column of their own and Emotional Intelligence's third descriptor in a row of its own with empty SN and competence cells. Printed as given, the second page of the list looked like a different table. Rebuilt in the first table's shape, with its header repeated over the continuation. One descriptor carries two items run together in the source cell ('Distinguish types of love Apply emotional intelligence…'), separated here.
